name: Carle Foundation Hospital Student Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at Carle Foundation Hospital as a high school or college student. The program has about 500 students each semester.
who_can_apply: High school volunteers must be 14 or older. Students must provide up-to-date immunization records.
deadline_text: Applications are due by 5 p.m. on August 29 (fall term), November 15 (spring term) or April 15 (summer term). The page gives no year.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now button under 'Students (college/teen)' on the Carle Foundation Hospital volunteer page (opens an online application) and send immunization records.
notes: The next listed deadline is the spring term deadline of November 15; confirm the year and current rules with Carle Volunteer Services. Other Carle sites list their own teen age ranges.
